headline: Jets rookie WR Omar Cooper Jr. put on IR with sprained ankle
summary: Jets rookie wide receiver Omar Cooper Jr., one of the team's three first-round picks, has been placed on injured reserve with a sprained ankle.

headline: Ravens' Zay Flowers downgraded to out because of hamstring injury
summary: The Baltimore Ravens downgraded Pro Bowl wide receiver Zay Flowers to out for Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints.

headline: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold Could Be Out Until October
summary: The Seahawks have been hesitant to provide a clear timeline for the return of quarterback Sam Darnold from the injury he suffered in Week 1. Initial concerns about Darnold’s hip were allayed by testing that indicated his glute was impacted instead. headline: Rams' Puka Nacua again misses practice, questionable for MNF
summary: Rams receiver Puka Nacua will not practice for the second day in a row and will be listed as questionable for Monday night's game against the Giants.

headline: Packers downgrade DT Javon Hargrave to out, remove DE Lukas Van Ness from injury report
summary: When the Packers face the Jets on Sunday, they won't have defensive tackle Javon Hargrave.
